question: The word "fragmented" means:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Broken into pieces.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fragmented"** means:

 
 
• Broken into separate parts or pieces; not whole or complete. (टुकड़ों में बंटा हुआ)
 
 
 
• **Example:** After the earthquake, the city was left fragmented with many buildings destroyed.
 
• **"Correct answer"** means:
 
 
• Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured her a perfect score.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Broken into pieces**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Whole and complete** (पूरा और समग्र): Intact; not broken or divided.

 
 
• **Example:** He found the puzzle piece that made the picture whole and complete.
 
 
 
• **Peaceful** (शांतिपूर्ण): Calm and free from disturbance or conflict.
 
 
• **Example:** The lake was peaceful and serene, perfect for relaxation.
 
 
 
• **Deeply focused** (गहन रूप से केंद्रित): Concentrating with intensity on a particular task or subject.
 
 
• **Example:** She was deeply focused on her studies, preparing for the upcoming exams.
 
 

43:Td2a,

The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Staying connected excessively.
